bannedPhrases: at the end of the day

semrushOptimization._doc: Universal writing quality rules for achieving high SEO Writing Assistant scores. Applies to all niches.

readability._sentenceNote: Split any sentence over 25 words. Target 15-20 words per sentence.
readability._passiveNote: Convert ALL passive voice to active.
readability._paragraphNote: Split any paragraph over 4 sentences. Use bullet lists for 3+ items.
readability._complexWordsNote: Replace multi-syllable words with simpler synonyms where meaning is preserved. Niche-specific technical terms are exempt — only replace general vocabulary.

toneOfVoice._toneNote: Content should be 'somewhat formal' — professional but accessible. Measure consistency percentage.
toneOfVoice._fillerNote: Replace 'add up' -> 'total/sum', 'in order to' -> 'to'. Remove the rest entirely or restructure the sentence.
avoidCasualPatterns: Sentence-fragment headings should still read as complete thoughts
Avoid question-only headings when a statement works
Don't start sentences with emotional appeals in instructional content
Replace colloquial phrases with professional alternatives
toneOfVoice._itIsNote: 'It is not filed...' -> 'The form is not filed...' or 'You do not file...'. 'It is' is an unnecessary placeholder.

originality._note: Always run a plagiarism/originality check before publishing. Paraphrase common boilerplate that may match other articles.
